capabilities: create a note in a floating Obsidian window
trigger note creation from a command
open a quick note by right-clicking the Obsidian app icon
configure the quick note title in settings
extras: Platform support is incomplete: Windows and Linux icon-launch support are listed as TODO, and creating a note fails when Obsidian is running but minimised with no available windows.
motivation: The author started the plugin from a feature request in the Obsidian forum.
problem: Obsidian only creates notes inside the main window, so capturing a thought requires focusing the app and navigating before typing.
summary: Quick note creator that opens a new note in a floating Obsidian window via a command or a right-click on the app icon.
